howTo.title: Register for AGPO (30% of government tenders are set aside for youth, women and persons with disabilities)
steps: Check eligibility: youth aged 18–34, women, or persons with disabilities. The business must be a registered legal entity with at least 70% of its members, and 100% of its leadership, from the target group.

Collect original scans of: national ID or passport; business registration certificate or certificate of incorporation; CR12 for limited companies (system-generated); partnership deed for partnerships; KRA tax compliance certificate. Persons with disabilities also need their NCPWD registration document.
Apply on agpo.go.ke and keep the AGPO certificate. Attach it when bidding for tenders marked as reserved for your group.
Also register on the IFMIS Supplier Portal (supplier.treasury.go.ke). Nyamira county and Assembly works tenders are submitted there electronically.

howTo.title: Where Nyamira public jobs are advertised
steps: County Public Service Board portal (cpsb.nyamira.go.ke): online applications, with each post's deadline and status shown.
County website 'Careers/Job Opportunity Documents' list (nyamira.go.ke/templates/document_list?id=3): adverts, shortlists and interview schedules as PDFs.
County Assembly vacancies page (nyamiraassembly.go.ke/index.php/vacancies.html), which is updated irregularly. The newest posted item is a 2024 Speaker's-office vacancy.
Applicants should expect to need KRA, HELB, EACC, DCI (good conduct) and CRB clearances if shortlisted. The CPSB states it charges no fees, so do not pay anyone promising a job.

howTo.title: Where Nyamira tenders are advertised
steps: County tenders list: nyamira.go.ke/templates/document_list?id=1 (each item is marked Open or Closed).
County Assembly tenders: nyamiraassembly.go.ke/index.php/tenders.html, especially the 'Tender Notices' and 'Tender docs 2026/2027' folders.
National Public Procurement Information Portal (tenders.go.ke) and the IFMIS Supplier Portal (supplier.treasury.go.ke). Most works tenders are submitted electronically on IFMIS.
Read each advert for mandatory site visits, which usually fall a week before closing, and for tender security amounts.

howTo.title: Typical NG-CDF bursary steps (based on the Kitutu Masaba 2025/26 notice)
steps: Watch for the constituency notice, usually in December for the new school year. Tertiary and senior-secondary forms may be released on different dates.
Get the form from the constituency NG-CDF website or office (for example, kitutumasaba.co.ke).
Fill it in and return it in person to the designated centre on the date in the constituency circular.
Confirm dates directly with your constituency NG-CDF office: Borabu, Kitutu Masaba, North Mugirango or West Mugirango.

notes: Three items are open as of 22 Oct 2026, all of them tenders: the county framework tenders (close 28 Oct), the Nyamira Municipality paving-block road (closes 26 Oct; its mandatory site visit on 19 Oct has already passed), and the Assembly medical insurance cover (closes 26 Oct). No open county or Assembly job adverts were found.

'reserved': null means no youth, women or PWD (AGPO) reservation was stated in the advert we read. None of the 2026 Nyamira county or Assembly tenders reviewed was reserved. The framework advert says tendering is open to all qualified tenderers, and the Assembly septic-tank lots are marked 'OPEN – ALL'.

Published dates for county-website PDFs are taken from the upload timestamp in the file name (for example, 17_10_2026 = 17 Oct 2026). The September health advert and the CPSB portal both give 15 Sep 2026 as the start date.
All 27 vacancies on cpsb.nyamira.go.ke (portal total = 27) belong to the September 2026 health recruitment. The listings checked show deadline 2026-10-06 and status Closed.

Nyamira County Government (ward) bursary: no 2025/26 or 2026/27 application notice with dates was found on nyamira.go.ke or in KNA or media. The latest reports found describe disbursements (KSh66m in July 2024; KSh126m in June 2021), not application windows. The county homepage mentions that 709 VTC trainees from 26 VTCs received full or partial scholarships with the KCB Foundation, but gives no date or application details.

No 2025/26 or 2026 NG-CDF bursary notice with dates was found for Borabu or North Mugirango. Kitutu Masaba and West Mugirango notices from Dec 2025 are listed as closed examples, sourced through media and aggregators because ngcdf.go.ke pages were not found.
No Nyamira-specific NYOTA, Ajira or Hustler Fund notice was found, only national coverage, so none is listed. The national NYOTA programme had application coverage in Sep 2026 (thekenyatimes.com).
The County Assembly vacancies page lists only older documents (May 2022 advert, 2024 Speaker's-office vacancy) with no dates. No 2026 Assembly job advert was found.

Aggregator sites (opportunitiesforyoungkenyans.co.ke, educationnewshub.co.ke) were used only where an official copy was not reachable. Verify against the constituency or county office before publishing.
